summary: Iteration 4-b frontend verification. Tested (1) PII Heatmap removal in 3 states, (2) NoteField auto-open on preset apply with plan.note, and full iteration-4 regression. 16/16 assertions PASS after correcting one test-script assertion (field name is column_header, not header, in JSON log — code was correct all along).
critical_code_review_comments: NoteField in DetectionView.jsx correctly syncs open state via useEffect on plan.note — reactive behavior verified.
PIIHeatmap.jsx file is unused but still on disk; safe to delete for cleanliness (not blocking).

add-note-<i> / note-input-<i> testids are duplicated across mobile card layout and desktop table (both render, one is hidden via Tailwind md: classes). Not a bug but callers must scope selectors (e.g., under [data-testid=detection-table]) to avoid ambiguity.
seed_data_creation: None; used built-in SAMPLE_CSV via use-sample-btn and inline batch CSV.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 4-b acceptance criteria verified: (a) [data-testid=pii-heatmap] absent on landing, after sample load, and inside expanded batch item; no 'PII HEATMAP' heading anywhere. (b) Preset containing a reviewer note auto-opens note-input-<i> textarea on apply (plan.note useEffect works) with correct value. Regressions verified: masthead has no banner/pills, all 4 single-mode downloads succeed (clean/json/pdf/zip), signed JSON logs contain signature block when sig-key-input filled, reviewer_note flows into transformations[].reviewer_note (empty note serializes as null), mobile 390 and tablet 820 have zero horizontal overflow, mode toggle works, batch add-files + batch-apply-btn produces redactorium-batch-*.zip. Note: JSON log uses column_header (not header) as the field key.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Initial test-script confusion on JSON field name was resolved by inspecting downloaded log.
